description: This 3D bar chart, from the paper "Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners: A Comprehensive Evaluation and Beyond," illustrates the accuracy of two large language models, Davinci-003 and BARD, across different generations of a classification task. The horizontal axis represents the "Generation" of the classification task, with categories labeled as "Davinci-003" and "BARD" along the x-axis, while the vertical axis represents "Accuracy," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8. The bars are colored with a gradient from blue at the bottom to yellow at the top, visually indicating the height of each bar corresponds to its accuracy value. The chart displays two sets of bars: for Davinci-003, the accuracy is approximately 0.45, and for BARD, it is approximately 0.25. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with the Davinci-003 bars appearing taller than the BARD bars, suggesting higher accuracy for Davinci-003 across the generations shown. The bars are not sorted, and no specific visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any particular bar.
